title: MS41.0 magic-command normal-mode entry (DS2 0x2A)
user_description: Adds DS2 command 0x2A as a normal-mode entry into the persistent Soft-BSL loader on MS41.0 while leaving the standard 0x43 adaptation-clear command intact.
description: MS41.0 unknown-command splice -> enter flash mode (E740=1 + commit + reset) -> reboot to the SA1 0x5A loader. Leaves 0x43 clear-adapts intact.
